discovery_basis.established_pattern: large-capacity history reliability > natural history reliability > visitor-pooled history reliability

primary_validation.statistic: validation-only reliability of the four-repeat history mean from the fixed-start crossed variance decomposition
primary_validation.inference: 1999 paired visitor-history bootstrap resamples, RNG seed 1032027
strong_success_rule: 95% paired-bootstrap interval for large_plant_capacity minus natural reliability entirely > 0
95% paired-bootstrap interval for visitor_pooled minus natural reliability entirely < 0
primary_validation.weak_success_rule: observed ordering holds but one or both paired-bootstrap intervals include zero

secondary_validation: history-structured variance and demographic residual variance in each intervention
mixed-sign history counts across three starts after averaging four repeats, epsilon 0 and 0.01
mean far-minus-near response and terminal occupancy for every arm
stopping: run exactly histories 75001-75128 and demographic seeds 301-304; no history/seed extension, replacement, threshold tuning or outcome-based stopping
claim_boundary: This tests transfer to new synthetic visitor histories, not natural islands.
The primary ordering was frozen before any new-history execution.
Capacity scaling and visitor pooling are biological interventions, not pure statistical manipulations.
No natural variance component, prevalence, evolutionary rate or field effect size is inferred.
Failure demotes the general-history mechanism claim even if the earlier same-history demographic validation succeeded.
